div.head: II Cn 38.1
div.ab: ⁊ á swa man byð mihtigra oððe maran hádes, swa scæl he deoppor for Gode ⁊ for worulde unriht gebetan.
And á swa man byð mihtra oððe maran hades, swa sceal he deoppor for Gode ⁊ for weorulde unriht gebetan.
Semperque, sicut homo potentior est uel maioris ordinis, sic debet sollertius pro Deo et seculo quod iniustum est emendare.
⁊ a swa man bið mihtigra oððe maran hades, swa sceal hé deoppor for Gode ⁊ for worulde unriht gebetan.
And a swa man byð mihtigra oððe maran hades, swa scæl he deoppor for Gode and for worulde unriht gebetan.
Und je mächtiger oder höheren Standes immer jemand ist, um so tiefer soll er Unrecht kirchlich und weltlich büssen.
And the more powerful or the higher in rank anyone is, the more deeply must he atone for wrong before God and before the world.
And in all cases, the greater a man is and the higher his rank, the more stringent shall be the amends which he shall be required to make to God and to men for lawless behaviour.
And ever as a man is mightier or of higher rank, he must atone the deeper both to God and to men for wrong-doing.
And always, the mightier a person is or the higher his rank, so must he do penance for his crimes all the more sincerely before God and the world.
